# FLX-3708: fitting needs the calibrate extra

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The fit runs CMA-ES, which the [calibrate] extra installs together with the SQL libraries the queries need: pip install 'flux-sim-engine[calibrate]'. Declared calibration, fluxsim calibrate BUNDLE, needs none of it. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3708
```
